county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Record Storage- Location (26 TAC §746.907(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the personnel records were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have form 2985 notarized.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was determined an infant was placed in a play yard in another room unsupervised and sustained minor injuries.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §747.2705(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence of Corporal Punishment was observed from video footage obtained from the operation cameras.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §747.2705(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff were found yelling at the children in their care.
